protocol.price_units: nominal GBP/MWh; no full-month CPI adjustment in forecast inputs
protocol.supply: daily_generation_total + independent wind_farm_generation; daily mean MW
protocol.validation_criterion: mean validation squared error after train-only target standardisation; equal target/horizon weights; average across three seeds
protocol.models: one-layer tanh RNN(64) vs one-layer LSTM(32), matched linear residual readout; 0.1 final-state dropout
protocol.evaluation: Fixed weights after training; forecast origins roll daily with newly observed history. All forecast targets stay inside their split; no refit after validation.
limitations: Frozen retrospectively repaired dataset. Source reconstruction/publication vintages were not re-created, so this is not an audited real-time data-vintage backtest.
Strict-target metrics exclude estimated/reconstructed target dates but retain the same calendar and input windows; they do not remove all reconstruction influence in inputs.
2026 partial year unused. No external data, fuel-disaggregated covariates or MPC profit experiment in this pilot.
protocol.evaluation_note: Only quality-label parsing changed after training; numeric input features, targets, models, validation selection and saved weights unchanged.
